rules.coverage: PQC connection segments / all in-scope connection segments, including unknowns, multiplied by 100. Empty coverage is unavailable; display rounds to one decimal.
rules.unit: Connection segment; device-to-gateway and gateway-to-cloud links count separately. Inventory filters do not change global coverage.
rules.freshnessBoundary: Evaluate each observation against the reporting clock. Exactly 24 hours is current; greater than 24 hours is stale. Future observations and future snapshot time prevent an all-clear.
rules.statusPrecedence: Suspected downgrade -> investigate; otherwise empty/unknown/stale/future evidence -> insufficient evidence; otherwise expected fallback -> migration remaining; otherwise reported segments migrated. Coexisting evidence reasons remain applicable. Migration is not a system-security guarantee.
